x-fc-supplement.title: Unified webhook subscriptions of accounts
x-fc-supplement.source: accounts tag v1.4.24 @ 300cc8435e6fa17e2ac274b88289a2cc7b945fcd (2026-10-22 08:31 -03:00, the one running in production), read only
x-fc-supplement.reason: The portal's unified specification (13-10 snapshot) does not have these routes. They are taken from the code for the trigger and the Webhooks resource. If a new snapshot includes them, the generator ignores this supplement.
x-fc-supplement.key_access: Open to API keys in accounts v1.4.24 (allowed list of config/platform-gate.php), except rotate-secret and activate. They need webhooks:read (GET) or webhooks:write (the rest) through permission_prefix, a key of the account owner and, also, the read permission of the area of each event type (accounts:read, conversations:read, communities:read): 422 when creating or changing events without it; 403 permission_denied when reading, changing, deleting or testing a subscription with events of an area the key cannot read.

tags.name: WebhookSubscription
tags.description: A subscription receives, on an https URL, the chosen events of the three areas (accounts, conversations and communities) with a single secret and a single delivery history.

get.x-fc-purpose: Use it to see all the subscriptions of the account, also the ones other integrations or people created.
get.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

post.x-fc-purpose: Use it to register an https URL and choose the events it receives. The response has the secret only once: keep it to verify the signature.
post.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

201.description: The created subscription, with `secret` (the only time it is shown).

get.x-fc-purpose: Use it to see the URL, events, filter and status of a subscription. It never includes the secret.
get.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

put.x-fc-purpose: Use it to change the URL (for example, when your tunnel changes), the events or the filter, or to pause and resume a subscription. It replaces the whole subscription and the secret does not change.
put.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

delete.x-fc-purpose: Use it to remove a subscription. Its events and delivery history are deleted with it. Do not delete the ones you do not recognize: they may belong to another integration of the account.
delete.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

get.x-fc-purpose: Use it to review each delivery attempt of a subscription: HTTP status, error and duration, newest first.
get.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Only the attempts of this event type.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Only the attempts of this event (`evt_…`).

post.x-fc-purpose: Use it to test your receiver: sends a single webhook.test event signed like a real one, without retries, and keeps it in the history.
post.x-fc-note: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).

200.description: Result of the attempt (answers 200 even if the destination fails).

url.description: Public `https` URL that receives the deliveries. Without user or password; an internal address is rejected.

events.description: Event types of the catalog (`GET /api/v1/webhooks/events`) that can be subscribed to. With an API key, each type needs the read permission of its area.

description.description: Text to recognize the subscription in the list.

filters.description: Optional filter by campaigns (`campaign_ids`): with a filter, an event without a campaign is not delivered.

url.description: Public `https` URL that receives the deliveries.

events.description: The full list of event types: it replaces the previous one.

description.description: Text to recognize the subscription in the list.

status.description: Pause or resume the subscription. It cannot be set to `disabled`.
